prompt.content: Where was Cyclone Erica located when it was designated as a Tropical Cyclone by TCWC-Brisbane on 4 March 2003?

output: Cyclone Erica was located approximately **1,000 km (620 miles) south-southeast of Darwin, Australia** when it was designated as a Tropical Cyclone by the **Tropical Cyclone Warning Centre (TCWC) in Brisbane, Australia** on **4 March 2003**.
reference: 790 km (490 mi) east-southeast of Townsville, Queensland.
